envelope.text: an event callback takes the caller's GENERATED

why: issue 2024 -- a TEMPLATE over the callable rather than upstream's `std::function<void(const rcl_interfaces::msg::ParameterEvent&)>`: there is no runtime typesupport, so the event type is DEDUCED from the callback's parameter (a lambda, a function pointer or a `std::function`) and filled by that type's own generated `ffi_deserialize`. Every upstream call site (`add_parameter_event_callback(cb)`) compiles unchanged once `rcl_interfaces` is generated for the image. Hosted only. See `cpp:ParameterEventHandler`.
